companies.title: Companies
companies.description: Company domains (e.g. amazon.com) or Trustpilot review page URLs (e.g. https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.amazon.com).

maxReviewsPerCompany.title: Max reviews per company
maxReviewsPerCompany.description: Maximum reviews to return for each company. Each review is billed as one event. Trustpilot shows logged-out visitors 200 reviews per filter; above 200 the actor splits the request by star rating, for up to 1,000 per company and language.

stars.title: Star ratings
stars.description: Only reviews with these star ratings. Leave empty for all.

language.title: Review language
language.description: "all" or a 2-letter language code (en, de, fr, es, it, nl, da, sv, pt, pl, ...).

sort.title: Sort
sort.description: Most recent first, or Trustpilot's relevance order. Delta mode ("Only reviews since") always uses most recent.

sinceDate.title: Only reviews since (delta mode)
sinceDate.description: Only reviews published on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Paging stops once older reviews are reached, so scheduled runs only pay for new reviews.

onlyNew.title: Only new reviews (monitoring)
onlyNew.description: Return only reviews not returned by an earlier run with the same companies, stars and language. Schedule the actor daily for new-review alerts: the first run is a baseline, later runs output (and bill) only new reviews. State is kept in the key-value store "trustpilot-reviews-state" in your account.

includeCompanyInfo.title: Include company profile
includeCompanyInfo.description: Add a "company" object to each review: website, categories, country, contact details, reply rate and star distribution. Company name, TrustScore and total reviews are always included.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. The actor works without a proxy. Use Apify Proxy (e.g. residential) if you run many companies and see blocking.
